title: Efficacy and safety of Ropivacaine injection in the management of post-operative pain: A comparison of plane block versus wound infiltration for post-operative analgesia in lumbar arthrodesis surgery.
official: Efficacy and safety of Ropivacaine injection in the management of post-operative pain: A comparison of plane block versus wound infiltration for post-operative analgesia in lumbar arthrodesis surgery.
summary: Main objective: Determine the reduction in morphine consumption in mg

interventions.name: Ropivacaine B. Braun 10 mg/ml injektionsvätska, lösning

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Participant must be ≥18 years old at the time of signing the Informed Consent
2. To have a lumbar arthrodesis programmed at the Hospital Universitari Arnau de Vilanova de Lleida
3. ASA grade I-III
4. Participant must be capable of giving Informed Consent
Exclusion criteria:
1. Specific contraindications for Ropivacaine treatment
2. Other medical conditions or comorbidities which, in the opinion of the Investigator, would interfere with study compliance or data interpretation
3. Mujeres embarazadas o en periodo de lactancia
4. IMC >35
5. Known medical history or evidence of severe liver disease and/or renal impairment (eGFR <30).
6. Previous back surgery
7. Evidence of immunological diseases
8. Evidence of malignancy
9. Systemic active infection that requires treatment
10. Skin disease at the puncture site
11. Active psychiatric disorder, including, but not limited to schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, or severe depression requiring current pharmacological intervention
